description: Release version headers on every /api/node/v1 request and response. Additive: no request or response body changes. The node sends its release version; while the coordinator enforces a release policy it answers with the latest published release and the minimum release still offered new jobs (the release before latest), and tells a node older than the minimum that it must update. Such a node still authenticates, heartbeats and finishes work it holds, but gets lease null until it updates. A node that sends no version is treated as legacy_node_version.
